messages:
amanda: Heads-up: during the midnight automated ACME + internal CA chain merge in eu-west we had a spike of mTLS rejects from a subset of internal services. ~1.8% failed for ~12 minutes.
theo: When did jobs run? any RBAC ops near that window?
amanda: rotation job finished at 00:07, failures started 00:08 and stopped at ~00:20. We also ran a cert-fetcher RBAC tighten at 23:58 last night.
rachel: Observed errors in the proxy logs: `tls: bad certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` but the leaf cert was present. Tracing shows the concatenated chain had leaf + root (missing intermediate).
cert-bot: ACME job eu-2026-07-22-00:07: assembled chain from files: /var/acme/chains/abc123.pem -> [leaf, root]. Intermediate retrieval attempted from internal CA store.
amanda: Hypothesis: RBAC change prevented the rotation job from reading the internal CA store for a short window, so the chain fell back to acme-provided root only. Some internal clients require the intermediate to be presented.
theo: Can we confirm KMS logs? rotator contacts KMS to unwrap CA keys before assembling chain. If unwrap failed due to IAM, that would match.
amanda: Pulled KMS audit entries: 3 denied decrypt RPCs for principal `svc/cert-rotator-eu@...` between 00:05-00:09. Example log: `audit: methodName=google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt principalEmail=svc/cert-rotator-eu@project reason=PERMISSION_DENIED`
security-oncall: Did customer-facing traffic show impact? metrics: 0.2% increase in error-rate for internal API calls, no external customers impacted, but some downstream jobs retried aggressively. Treat as near miss.
rachel: Quick mitigation we did: temporarily re-bound decrypt to cert-rotator-eu, re-triggered rotation, and force-synced chains. That fixed the missing intermediate in ~3 minutes.
amanda: Immediate follow-ups: add correlation_id across rotation -> kms unwrap -> proxy deploy; add preflight chain validation in rotation job; and enforce atomic RBAC migration pattern (stage grant -> migrate -> revoke).
theo: +1 for preflight. I can add an `openssl verify -CAfile` step to CI. snippet:

```
# verify assembled chain
openssl verify -CAfile intermediate.pem assembled-chain.pem
```
cert-bot: filed ticket CERT-AUD-338 to add chain-validation gate and include request_id linking to KMS unwrap logs.
security-oncall: Can we increase KMS audit retention in eu to 90d temporarily for correlation? ops-bot: request logged as KMS-EU-AUD-90.
amanda: Also spotted config drift: a few proxies still have `tls_min_version: TLS1_2` in staging; recommend scheduling TLS1.3-only for east-west after canary.
theo: We'll generate inventory of services in eu-west with tls_min_version < 1.3 and plan a 5% canary next week.
security-oncall: TO-DOs from thread:
- Add preflight chain validation to rotation job (theo)
- Add correlation_id/request_id propagation across rotator/KMS/proxy logs (amanda)
- Implement staged RBAC migration pattern in runbook (security-oncall)
- Increase KMS audit retention for eu region to 90d (ops-bot/cloud-admin)
- Inventory services with TLS <1.3 and schedule canary (theo)
ops-bot: NOTE: temporary binding granted to svc/cert-rotator-eu until 2026-07-23T04:00Z to unblock triage. Ticket CERT-AUD-338 created.
security-oncall: I'll draft a short postmortem template and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow. thanks folks. :eyes:
